'''L'raak''' was a [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrip]] that, along with [[Sterrin]] and [[Renak]], served the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Archon (Hutt)|Archon]] [[Szajin]] as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]<ref name="TOR" /> around [[3638 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> L'raak was equipped with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic arm]] with a mounted cannon, and wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. The trio were assigned to the [[Cartel mining mesa]], where they were [[Death/Legends|slain]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
L'raak, Renak, and Sterrin appear in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as Champion bosses on Makeb. Unlike other enemy NPCs, they will not attack players within range but only when attacked. They are not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of an achievement; this article assumes 100% game completion, which means they were killed.<ref name="TOR" />
